title: Delivery Fees
description:
You've sent a package, and it was completely free of charge. But perhaps you want to trade with the recipient. In that case, you'll want a payback tag. And for that, I'll need to introduce you to Services.
Services are special addresses that work in various services such as the mail crafting system. For a payback tag, you'll want to package an address tag with red dye and use another address tag to set the destination to "Mail Service". Then it's a simple matter of mailing the package like normal and waiting for the return.
There are several mail recipes, and you can view them all with JEI.
